Players Committee card image of [[R-3PO (Ar-Threepio) (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Destiny +1 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. During your control phase, if with opponent's Undercover spy, opponent loses 2 Force (may not be reduced). If a spy here 'breaks cover' or is lost, may place R-3PO in Used Pile.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/r3poarthreepio.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
